opportunities.name: Self-ball windup
opportunities.objective: Keep the ball on Orianna while ramping same-target attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Clockwork Windup's AP magic damage increases across attacks on one target within four seconds. Self E adds shield and ball resists while W supplies escape speed. Nashor supports attacks; Dusk provides one spell-followed attack and Cosmic reacts to magic packets.
opportunities.requiredState: Ball attached to self, stable attack target and less than four seconds between attacks.
opportunities.failure: Attack range forces exposure or repeated target switching discards passive ramp.
opportunities.test: Measure first three passive attack packets and damage prevented by self E while alternating versus holding targets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeating an on-hit does not establish an extra Clockwork Windup stack.

opportunities.name: Protect then pulse
opportunities.objective: Use an ally ball carrier to distribute utility and damage in one engagement.
opportunities.mechanic: E shields and supplies attached resists; Staff rewards allied shielding with AP/haste, then W and R originate at the ally's ball. Helia requires Orianna's champion damage before the next E shield. Shurelya supports the carrier's entry; AP improves shield and pulse damage.
opportunities.requiredState: An allied diver carries the ball within tether range and E is available after champion damage.
opportunities.failure: Automatic ball return invalidates placement or the ally dies before shielding.
opportunities.test: Record ball position, shield amount and Helia consumption for E-before-damage versus damage-before-E.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Ball attachment does not transfer Orianna's items to the carrier.

ruledOut.reason: Windup increases only for subsequent attacks on the same target within four seconds, with a cap.

unknowns: Passive repeated-on-hit stacking and Helia attribution from remote ball hits need live confirmation.

builds.name: Self-ball windup

builds.goal: Keep the ball on Orianna while ramping same-target attacks.
builds.hypothesis: Clockwork Windup's AP magic damage increases across attacks on one target within four seconds. Self E adds shield and ball resists while W supplies escape speed. Nashor supports attacks; Dusk provides one spell-followed attack and Cosmic reacts to magic packets.
testPlan: Required state: Ball attached to self, stable attack target and less than four seconds between attacks.
Measure first three passive attack packets and damage prevented by self E while alternating versus holding targets.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Attack range forces exposure or repeated target switching discards passive ramp.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeating an on-hit does not establish an extra Clockwork Windup stack.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Passive: The Ball adds [6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30] Armor and [6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / 30] Magic Resist to the allied champion it is attached to.

Active: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, granting them [55 / 90 / 125 / 160 / 195 + (0.45) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds. Enemies the Ball passes through take [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage.

Orianna commands her Ball to release an electric pulse, dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies.

The pulse leaves behind an energy field for [3] seconds, Slowing enemies by [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% and granting allies [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% Move Speed, decaying over [2] seconds.

Orianna's Abilities originate from her Ball. Orianna's Ball automatically returns to her if she is too far away from it.

Orianna's Attacks deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 50; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × AP] magic damage. Subsequent Attacks against the same target within [4] seconds deal an additional [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 50; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × AP) × (0.15)] magic damage (max of [(characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 50; raw flags preserved) + (0.15) × AP) × ((0.15) × (2))] damage).
